verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own pages say bizfile is its online portal for businesses to file. They say over 140 business filings and name reservations for corporations, LLCs and LPs are available online, Statements of Information can be filed online, and the fastest paid expedite service is provided online. The upcoming User Access requirement for Statement of Information filings adds an account step but keeps filing online. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that a filing completes end-to-end, and an explicit statement that formation filings and fee payment are done online.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Welcome to bizfile California, the Secretary of State’s online portal to help businesses file, search, and order business records.
Over 140 Business Filings, Name Reservations, and Orders for Certificates of Status and Certified Copies of Corporations, Limited Liability Companies and Limited Partnerships available online.
Statements of Information, Common Interest Development Statements and Publicly Traded Disclosure Statements can be filed online at bizfileOnline.sos.ca.gov.
Fastest Service is provided online at bizfileOnline.sos.ca.gov including 24-Hour Expedite ($350) and Same-Day ($750).
